methodology_notes: Exact raw tail counts at u>3.5 and u>4.5 for QCD were obtained by directly re-thresholding the real per-event score_spanet_10m column in FULL_QCD_SURVIVOR_SIDECAR.h5 (complete coverage above the SPA10M 7.5% WP boundary, score>=0.998958945274353).

Exact raw tail counts for ttbar and the 14 minor 'other' backgrounds were obtained by directly re-thresholding the per-event 'survivors' score lists inside the frozen job_summary_*.json files (same 7.5% WP coverage boundary).
No event was rescored; only already-computed, already-frozen per-event scores were re-thresholded at the two new exact cut values.

Weighted yield / N_eff / relative MC uncertainty use the flat per-process weight_450fb convention established throughout this project, reusing the exact formulas validated in track_b_harvey_score_tail_diagnostics_20260829_v5_background_stats_audit.

The u>4.5, all-background N_eff/rel.unc. (13.99 / 26.73%) independently reproduces the already-frozen eps_S=3.5% fine-scan working point to the digit -- an internal cross-check, not an independent claim.
Task 4 preselection ranking uses the matched-400k development cohort's SPA-Net-2M score as a statistically tractable proxy for the true (too-small) SPA-Net-10M tail, explicitly flagged as such.

Task 3 CPU-hour/wall-time figures reuse the project's own measured Pythia8+Delphes pilot rate (1.35 CPU-hr / 50,000 events, track_a_targeted_qcd_pilot_arm1_200to500_50k_20260814_v1), cross-validated against the independently-published TENFOLD_BACKGROUND_FEASIBILITY_MEMO.md 10x-scenario figure (agreement to within 0.2%).
